needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Extend and widen the footway to at least 1.5m and ensure it is clear of obstructions.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install barriers to prevent parking on the footway and ensure it remains clear for pedestrian use.

needed.evidence: uneven sections and trip hazards on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards and ensure a smooth walking surface.

needed.evidence: marked crossing without adequate safety measures
needed.suggestion: Install traffic signals and a refuge island to improve the safety of the crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: crossing is hard to see and obstructed
needed.suggestion: Add high-visibility markings and ensure the crossing is clear of obstructions to improve visibility and safety.

needed.evidence: no dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: street lighting is only some and not ample
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to ensure ample lighting along the road for safety.
